name: How much do aging-in-place renovations cost?

mainEntity.name: How much do aging-in-place renovations cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of aging-in-place renovations varies widely based on the scope and complexity of the project. Minor updates like grab bars or improved lighting might cost a few hundred dollars. More extensive changes such as a complete bathroom remodel with a curbless shower and wider door could range from $10,000 to $30,000 or more. Whole-home renovations involving ramps, stair lifts, and kitchen modifications can exceed $50,000. We provide detailed estimates after an initial consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs vary significantly based on project scope, from a few hundred dollars for minor updates to tens of thousands for extensive remodels. Detailed estimates are provided after consultation.
